posts.title: GitHub moves 99.99999% of repos to Azure with per-reference quorums
posts.summary: GitHub copied nearly all repositories to Azure and describes how per-reference quorums will migrate the remainder. Object storage lets reads scale independently of write paths, targeting agent-scale Git traffic.

posts.title: Preserving FlexClone space efficiency when migrating to FSx for NetApp ONTAP
posts.summary: File-level tools like rsync, robocopy and DataSync expand clones into full copies, losing space savings. The post explains how to migrate between ONTAP file systems while keeping clone relationships intact, on-prem to FSx, between FSx systems, or across accounts.

posts.title: PHP security release fixes two RCEs after coordinated disclosure leak
posts.summary: The PHP Foundation released updates across the 8.x line fixing two remote code execution bugs. Exploits circulated after the CVE IDs leaked during coordinated disclosure. Upgrade immediately.

posts.title: Re-encrypting existing S3 objects in place with UpdateObjectEncryption
posts.summary: S3 Batch Operations with the new UpdateObjectEncryption API can switch billions of objects from SSE-S3 to SSE-KMS in place. There is no data movement, and Lifecycle policies keep working.
